rationale: Chris and Kaushik both have deep robotics expertise but from complementary angles—Chris leads simulation work in TypeScript and Rust at Zhavia Labs, while Kaushik brings hands-on ML and embedded systems experience with Python and C++ at Mytra. Their combined skill set bridges the gap between simulation infrastructure and real-world robotics systems, making them valuable collaborators for projects that need both the software backbone and the ML/mechanical know-how.
intro_message: Chris Orlin Cardoza, meet Kaushik Prakash — you're both working in robotics but with different depth (simulation vs. ML/embedded), and your tech stacks complement each other well for building end-to-end systems.
